scope: Fresh-context individual A8 proof/contract review against common README, interfaces, requirements, K5/K6/D4 and relevant A3/A4/A5/A7 interfaces. Full A0-A8 composition is reserved for a separate review. Existing K5/K6/D4 acceptance receipts checked after reading the proofs; other architecture review receipts not consulted.

reasoning.memory: Summing disjoint concrete physical reservations is valid only with all-path allocation/alias containment, complete residual-memory accounting and joint stack/ISR nesting. A3 supplies checked address/alignment and synchronized lifetime premises. A8 lists backup, input/publication/checkpoint storage, metadata, allocator overhead and linked-code/runtime budgets; payload alone is explicitly inadequate.
reasoning.work: Disjoint operation categories with uniform count and cycle bounds give the sum bound. Retries, failed search, cold/miss, certificates, restores and diagnostics cannot disappear. A solver iteration cap proves bounded execution, not useful availability.
reasoning.service: A ready FIFO job that remains incomplete keeps its queue backlogged; the strict useful-service lower bound then supplies at least W+C by D and FIFO excludes later overtaking. This is a correct conditional K5 theorem. A8 does not prove a concrete arrival/backlog theorem: it expressly requires one to establish W, along with maximum rate, jitter, acquisition latency, publication freshness and a common clock.
reasoning.availability: A8 delegates useful availability and fallback to A5, which binds same-law containment and timely qualifying production/publication to D4. CPU completion alone does not prove useful enclosure construction, mandatory timely authorization, continued validity or lifetime outage limits. No always-refusing policy is accepted as useful.
reasoning.faults_and_lifetime: Overload refusal/quarantine must precede stale authority or ownership loss and invokes explicit missing-interval handling. Reset uses qualified aged-cell loss-of-history semantics; bounded retry, admitted fault/interrupt behavior, finite-horizon counter capacity and qualified rollover/invalidation are explicit obligations. Statistical risk cannot restart per boot. No arbitrary-corruption or reset persistence guarantee is inferred.
reasoning.closed_loop: Exact public value/status/timing refinement on every common prefix with identical controller/environment initialization and common disturbances supports the K6 induction. Bounded changes require all-reachable joint-state decision margins or full joint reachability; one saved-input replay cannot close feedback. The stochastic coupling must cover the full admitted process, as K6 requires.
reasoning.target_boundary: 16 MHz is nominal clock, 35 Hz is nominal configurable acquisition, 10240 bytes is an engineering SRAM target, and ten years is a finite design horizon with event/reset counts unbound. They are not measured useful service, a maximum stream rate, a verified full memory fit, or lifetime qualification. Host speedups are explicitly design evidence only.

counterexample_checks: A finite burst or long service blackout can violate deadlines despite acceptable average utilization: excluded by required service and backlog premises.
Later jobs overtaking or uncounted repeated recovery could defeat deadline/work bounds: excluded by FIFO and explicit disjoint all-path counts.
Simultaneous rollback/publication/ISR use can exceed payload totals: complete layout and nesting containment required.
Dropping inputs or relabeling stale results to meet a deadline would break physical chronology/authority: A8 mandates A4/A7 gap handling.
Reused epochs after reset or wrapping counters can revive stale handles: common nonreused identities and qualified rollover/invalidation required.
Arbitrarily close estimator outputs can select different threshold actions and future input: exact timed equivalence or joint bounded-change proof required.
Timely solver termination with permanently unresolved output does not satisfy D4 availability: A8 explicitly separates bounded execution from useful service.

remaining_application_obligations.obligation: Bind maximum arrivals, jitter, ready-job definition, interrupt/blocking/service envelope, all work counts/costs, finite backlog/admission policy, acquisition deadlines and publication expiry; prove them on the actual target.

Select a concrete representation and prove complete 10240-byte-target SRAM layout, checked sizes and counters, all-path workspace/backup/publication liveness, stack/ISR bounds and separately linked flash/runtime support.
Bind exact horizon, maximum event/reset/generation counts, rollover behavior, fault containment and history-loss recovery without reusing identities or restarting lifetime risk.

Qualify achievable informative/power scenarios, useful construction/publication deadlines, fallback safety, same-law probabilities and lifetime outage/risk semantics; resource boundedness is insufficient.
Establish timed public refinement or joint controller/plant/estimator reachability and test admitted controller/load timing on target.

validation.method: Manual premise-by-premise conditional-proof review, counterexample search and foundational-proof receipt hash verification. No implementation tests or sweeps applicable.

artifact_policy: New immutable review receipt; substantive source revisions require a new receipt and review. No original evidence overwritten.
